reviews.title: Download beware
reviews.text: I downloaded and installed this app without intending to use the paid version. I didn’t even use it and after 3 days I was starting to be billed $9.99 a month. This like many apps does its best to disguise when it’s going to charge you through multiple popups. I am typically good at avoiding these, but without going back and installing again, I’m going to guess that’s what happened.
